title: Pre-Market Brief — 11 Nov 2026
intro:
Crude oil is trading higher with WTI advancing 1.26 percent to 87.12 and Brent rising 1.46 percent to 92.83. The move is supported by ongoing geopolitical tensions, including reports regarding Iranian threats and regional stability in Eastern Europe.
Market theme
Risk appetite remains robust across equities despite aggressive selling in fixed income as the US 10-year yield jumps 11.9 basis points to 4.983 percent following Fed concerns over inflation. Meanwhile, the US dollar strengthens alongside commodities like crude oil and precious metals.
Potential scenario
Potential scenario for the US cash open: base case assumes Nasdaq 100 futures hold above 28,363 on persistent tech sector momentum, while the alternative sees rising yields pressuring equities toward a pullback, testing the S&P 500 futures level of 7,612.75.
Key risks
• Surging US Treasury yields weighing on broader equity valuations
• Geopolitical escalation risks involving Iran and Eastern Europe
